column1: # Structured config files deliberately left without a schema association.
# Read by schema-coverage-test, not by Checkrun. Every tracked JSON, JSONC,
# YAML, or TOML file in the dotfiles repos must match an association in
# associations.json or a pattern here, so a new config file cannot appear
# without someone deciding about its schema. Patterns use the association
# `matches` syntax and expansion. Each row needs a reason; when a public schema
# appears, delete the row and add an association instead.
